experiment: Live multitasking activity (sim.si_state), carried object (posture_state.carry_targets), catalog object name, and crafting recipe STBL context

mechanisms.si_state: Iterates sim.si_state for non-social, non-idle SuperInteractions and extracts display_name STBL key plus target.catalog_name STBL key.
mechanisms.carry_targets: Iterates sim.posture_state.carry_targets (left, right, back hands) to capture held plates, drinks, books, or tools even when the body posture is sim-stand.
mechanisms.crafting_recipe: Inspects target_obj.crafting_component.get_recipe().get_recipe_name() to extract the STBL key of crafted dishes and drinks.

impact_on_dialogue: In Experiment 11 (chat-1792578161129-2), Rieko Okada referenced Alex Keen sitting on his loveseat ("Empty. But in a fancy way, because you have a loveseat.") directly from the resolved seating_Sit target_label.
limits: Cooking interactions that end before a social starts are no longer in si_state unless the Sim is carrying the resulting plate/dish in posture_state.carry_targets or eating it.
